crossRefs.note: Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

people.name: Gaal
people.line: Son of Ebed; led a revolt against Abimelech.

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
translations.bsb: So Gaal went out before the leaders of Shechem and fought against Abimelech,
translations.kjv: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
translations.asv: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
